body:
## Executive summary

PR #6 remains open and Draft. It now contains the v0.1 local foundation plus corrective runtime/test stabilization. It does not claim that Phases 8–13 are functional: the gap matrix records the remaining work and the next phases will be delivered as separate substantial PRs.

## Corrective changes

- `bf6d332` fixes Windows Rust/Tauri test startup (`STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND (0xc0000139)`) with a scoped MSVC test manifest/build configuration.
- `8a3b193` stabilizes the five failures exposed after startup recovery: forward migration 0021, legacy capability parsing, fixture ownership/FK setup, and companion internal-vs-external device ID handling.
- `71ae308` adds `docs/CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md`, comparing the original roadmap, the previous PR claim, actual behavior, missing engineering, validation, and status classification.

## Current evidence

- Local `pnpm tauri:check`: Rust fmt/check/clippy plus 113 library tests passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored only for the optional local Ollama model.
- Local `scripts/build-runtime.ps1`: PyInstaller sidecar smoke passed; `aip-runtime.exe` SHA-256 `052E3BE00C97A7FBB05B346C17D4F3F792E006BE432C64796ED11A860FBF05E7`.
- Local `pnpm --filter @aip/desktop tauri build`: release build passed and produced NSIS and MSI bundles under `apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle`.
- Remote CI for this new head is pending; no remote success is claimed until the phase-zero and package jobs complete.

## Truthful phase status

- Phases 0–6 and 7A: APPROVED baseline as previously reviewed.
- Phases 7B–7F: FOUNDATION ONLY pending independent review and the corrective acceptance gate.
- Phase 8: FOUNDATION ONLY; synthetic metadata exists, but real local audio/STT/TTS/wake/custom voice is not implemented.
- Phase 9: FOUNDATION ONLY; manifests/fixtures exist, but real root-scoped supervised effects and provider-neutral adapters are not implemented.
- Phase 10: FOUNDATION ONLY; catalog/lifecycle metadata exists, but no sandboxed extension execution exists.
- Phase 11: FOUNDATION ONLY; synthetic visual contracts exist, but no Windows capture/visual adapter exists.
- Phase 12: MISSING; no real Android project/APK or authenticated desktop transport exists.
- Phase 13: MISSING; no real AIP-side authenticated socket gateway exists.

## Boundaries

AIP remains standalone. No BielOS import, telemetry, public listener, secrets/private data, force push/reset/rebase, or weakened safety gate was added. Rust/SQLite remain authoritative; ownership, bounded payloads, replay/idempotency, audit, safe-mode and temporary-chat controls remain fail-closed.

## Next work

After remote CI and independent Biel4 review approve this corrective PR, merge only the verified foundation. Then implement Phases 8–13 in separate PRs with real local runtime behavior, deterministic tests, package/APK/gateway evidence, and distinct Architect/Executor/Reviewer provenance.

## Current status

FOUNDATION ONLY — local automated validation is green and packaging completed locally; remote CI, independent review, security/publication review, and human acceptance remain open. No merge or stable release is claimed.

## Final recommendation

HUMAN_VALIDATION_REQUIRED — keep PR #6 Draft until remote CI, independent review, and the remaining functional phase work are complete.
